snapshot.title: Time Jump — Recovery Initiation

fields.narration: Facilitator reads aloud: Time jump to 12:00 PM. The environment is clean. The MSSP has confirmed that OB-1 and the off-site backup service’s last good snapshot (2026-04-10 22:15) are valid for recovery. The recovery sequence under HUOG-ISP Section 9.3 has been authorized. The Systems & Cybersecurity Lead must now begin restoring the calibration share, followed by ops records, then the CP&L D-3 campaign. Verification against repository hashes will begin immediately for the calibration files. No further data transfer is permitted until integrity is confirmed.
worldState: The environment is clean and isolated.
OB-1 (offline drive) has been verified as unmounted and not infected.
The off-site backup service’s last good snapshot is from 2026-04-10 22:15.
The recovery sequence under HUOG-ISP Section 9.3 has been initiated.
The calibration share is being restored and verified against repository hashes.
The Systems & Cybersecurity Lead has confirmed the recovery plan is in progress.
No data has been transferred to processing workstations or GCS devices beyond the calibration share.
